description: Location-aware platform where the map is the primary interface. Industry brain defines what is being discovered or tracked on the map. This core defines how location, navigation, and proximity work.

three_js.description: Wireframe globe rotating slowly. Coordinate grid lines. Location pin dots appear and disappear across the surface.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Place has a Location and belongs to a Category
Pin is placed by User on the map — saved or custom
Route connects two or more Locations
Review belongs to User, written about a Place
CheckIn belongs to User at a Place
Tracking belongs to a moving entity (driver, shipment, delivery) with a live Location
Address is a resolved Location — street, city, coordinates
Search returns Places near a Location
Notification belongs to User, triggered by proximity or tracking events

layout.notes: The map is the product — it must never be hidden or collapsed. Everything else is an overlay or sidebar. Current location button always visible floating on the map.

avoid: Never replace the map with a list view as the default — map is always primary
Never show a bottom sheet that covers more than 65% of the map
Never use text labels on map pins for dense areas — use icons only, expand on tap
Never auto-start navigation without user explicitly tapping 'Start navigation'
Never show ETA without updating it in real time during navigation
Never use blue for anything other than the user's current location indicator
Never cluster pins beyond 3 levels of zoom aggregation — show individual pins at street level
Never hide the current location button — always visible on map overlay
enforce: Current location always shown as pulsing blue dot — never static
Current location button always visible — tap to re-centre map
Place detail always slides up from bottom — map stays visible behind
Pins cluster at low zoom — number shows count inside cluster
Category filter chips always visible above the map — horizontal scroll
Search bar always at top of map screen — even in navigation mode
Distance always shown in user's preferred unit (km/miles) — set in settings
Offline map indicator when no connection — show last downloaded area boundaries

empty_states.ui: Map shows default city view (not user location). Banner: 'Enable location for nearby results'. CTA: 'Enable location'. Search remains fully functional.

empty_states.trigger: No places in area match category
empty_states.ui: Map shows search area with no pins. Bottom sheet: 'No [category] found here'. CTA: 'Expand search area'. Show radius slider.
Bookmark illustration. Message: 'No saved places yet'. Instruction: 'Tap the bookmark icon on any place to save it'. CTA: 'Explore map'.

loading_states.ui: Map tiles load progressively — grey tiles replaced as they load. Pins appear after tiles in area loaded. Skeleton bottom sheet while place data loads.
Bottom sheet slides up immediately with skeleton content. Photo skeleton top, name skeleton, meta row skeleton. Real content replaces as loaded.
Route line appears first. Turn-by-turn instructions load within 1 second. ETA shows 'Calculating...' then updates. Never block navigation on slow data.

error_flows.ui: Banner: 'Could not calculate route'. Options: Try different transport mode, Check endpoints, Try again. Map still interactive during error.
Banner: 'GPS signal lost — last known position shown'. Pulsing dot becomes grey. Instructions paused. Auto-resumes when signal returns.
Place pin still tappable. Bottom sheet shows: 'Details unavailable for this location'. Show coordinates. Option to report as inaccurate.
Grey tiles for undownloaded areas. Banner: 'Offline — some areas unavailable'. Download prompt for current area. Cached areas fully functional.

edge_cases.ui: Dead reckoning — continue showing estimated position based on last known speed and direction. 'Estimating position' indicator. Resume GPS on exit.

edge_cases.case: Multiple pins at exact same location
edge_cases.ui: Stack indicator — top pin shows +N badge. Tap to expand into a list of places at that location. Never collapse all into one unnavigable cluster.

edge_cases.case: Long place name on pin label
edge_cases.ui: Truncate label to 15 characters on pin. Full name shown in bottom sheet. Never let pin label overlap adjacent pins.
Pin shown with grey overlay. 'Permanently closed' label in bottom sheet. Remove from active search results. Keep in saved places with closure notice.
